name: Differential Sampling and Peak Finding
aliases: Surface Raycasting with Adaptive Step Size
definition: A raycasting algorithm that combines differential sampling (adaptive step size) with peak finding (isosurface extraction) to locate isosurface intersections along a ray segment.
summary: Differential Sampling and Peak Finding renders sharp isosurfaces by combining adaptive ray sampling with explicit root-finding to locate transfer function peaks, avoiding undersampling errors.
